channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK keeps combat drone plans under wraps
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has declined to disclose details on the weapons, naming or timelines associated with a planned air-launched collaborative uncrewed air vehicle, citing commercial sensitivity and security concerns. The post UK keeps combat drone plans under wraps first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD distances itself from naval college upkeep
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said it works closely with organisations linked to the Old Royal Naval College but does not hold responsibility for the site’s heritage upkeep, employment or day-to-day public access. The post MOD distances itself from naval college upkeep first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK rules out expanding nuclear deterrent via F-35A
item.description: The government has said it has no plans to expand the UK’s nuclear deterrent beyond its submarine-based system. The post UK rules out expanding nuclear deterrent via F-35A first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy’s Proteus drone to fly in January
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said no weapon system has yet been selected for the Royal Navy’s planned uncrewed helicopter, while confirming that the Proteus demonstrator is expected to achieve its first flight this month. The post Royal Navy’s Proteus drone to fly in January first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Future of surplus Challenger 2 tanks remains undecided
item.description: No decision has yet been taken on the future of the Challenger 2 tanks that will not be upgraded under the Challenger 3 programme, the UK Defence Journal understands. The post Future of surplus Challenger 2 tanks remains undecided first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK enters assessment phase for Patria 6×6 vehicle
item.description: The UK has entered the assessment phase of a multinational armoured vehicle programme centred on the Patria 6x6, with no procurement decision yet taken, the UK Defence Journal understands. The post UK enters assessment phase for Patria 6×6 vehicle first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Defence plans £750m digital workplace services overhaul
item.description: The Ministry of Defence is preparing a major recompetition of its digital workplace services, with a future contract potentially worth up to £750 million over five years, according to a prior information notice. The post Defence plans £750m digital workplace services overhaul first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK rules out expeditionary force role in Greenland security
item.description: The UK has played down suggestions that the Joint Expeditionary Force could be deployed to Greenland, stressing that the island’s security is already guaranteed through NATO. The post UK rules out expeditionary force role in Greenland security first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Welsh Cavalry sharpen marksmanship in live-fire training
item.description: Soldiers from 1st The Queen’s Dragoon Guards have completed a week of live-fire marksmanship training in Cumbria aimed at maintaining combat readiness and weapons proficiency, according to the British Army. The post Welsh Cavalry sharpen marksmanship in live-fire training first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK confirms closure of less-lethal weapons advisory body
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the Scientific Advisory Committee on the Medical Implications of Less-Lethal Weapons has been closed, with its advisory role transferred to a Home Office body. The post UK confirms closure of less-lethal weapons advisory body first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
